body:

replies.author: Camemes
replies.body:
Greetings Traplord,

I have news for you, I have a tournament team ready to go and would like you in it.
You seen like a decent player and all so we would be thrilled to have you as a member on our team.
No positions are final until we see how everyone is so don't expect any promises.
My team is called The Kings and we are a tournament team.
Our only problem is our timezone, before we invite you, all we need is your skype and your timezone as
most of my team area Australian so I don't want to disadvantage you just because you don't live near us. But don't worry I'm sure we can figure out something.

Reply if u are interested in my offer.
